```yaml
name: Advanced Translation Check

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'lib/l10n/arb/**'
      - '.github/scripts/**'
      - '.github/workflows/advanced-translation-check.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read
  checks: write

jobs:
  translation-quality-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y gettext
          pip install translate-toolkit

      - name: Run Translate Toolkit Checks
        run: |
          python .github/scripts/translate_toolkit_check.py

      - name: Run Advanced Translation Checks
        run: |
          python .github/scripts/advanced_translation_check.py

      - name: Report Results
        if: always()
        uses: LouisBrunner/checks-action@6b626ffbad7cc56fd58627f774b9067e6118af23
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          name: Translation Quality Check
          status: completed
          conclusion: ${{ job.status }}
          output: |
            {
              "title": "Translation Quality Check Results",
              "summary": "Checks for brand name consistency, URL preservation, and translation quality metrics.",
              "text": "See job logs for detailed results."
            }
```
